verdict.rationale: Official quickstart docs walk through creating an index, adding documents, and running the first search, and a runtime probe confirms a real local install (brew) with a keyless index+search roundtrip completing in milliseconds with typo tolerance working out of the box. Community reports corroborate quick, easy setup ('literally zero config', 'very easy to get running') though a couple note initial onboarding friction for advanced settings. missing for 10: no independent third-party timed benchmark of the full quickstart flow start-to-finish.
